key_table_path.description: Path to the KeyTable file, which maps selectors to signing keys.

signing_table_path.description: Path to the SigningTable file, which maps sender addresses to signing keys.

internal_hosts.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges considered internal (i.e., trusted mail sources that may send unsigned mail).

external_ignore_list.description: List of networks whose outbound mail should be ignored by the verifier (i.e., not require DKIM signature validation).

mode.description: Operation mode: 's' = signing only, 'v' = verification only, 'sv' = both.

syslog_success.description: Log successful DKIM verifications to syslog (use only if debugging).

selector.description: DNS selector name used for publishing public keys (e.g., default._domainkey.example.com).

domain.description: Default signing domain (used when SigningTable does not match). Leave empty if using per-domain signing via SigningTable.

socket.description: Socket address for communication with MTA (e.g., Postfix). Use 'local:path' for Unix domain sockets, 'port@host' for TCP.

temp_file_directory.description: Directory for temporary files during signing/verification.

trusted_keys_hosts.description: List of public key fingerprints (e.g., 'SHA1:ab:cd:...') to trust for verification (rarely used). Each item is one line in a braces block.

items.description: A public key fingerprint in colon-separated hex (e.g., 'SHA1:ab:cd:ef:...').

signing_rules.description: List of signing rules mapping sender patterns to key files (e.g., for multi-domain setups). Each rule has a pattern (e.g., '*@example.com') and key path.

pattern.description: Pattern (e.g., '@example.com' or '*@*.example.org') matched against sender address.

key_path.description: Path to private key file for signing (e.g., '/etc/opendkim/keys/example.com/default.private').
